extracted.name: Homemade hot chocolate
extracted.description: Indulge in a homemade hot chocolate. Perfect as the cold nights draw in, you can add a pinch of chilli, cinnamon or a slug of rum if you like
ingredient_lines: 25g dark or plain chocolate finely chopped, plus a grating to serve
1 tbsp whipped cream or squirty cream
instruction_lines: Heat the milk, cocoa, sugar and chocolate in a small pan over a medium heat until steaming and the chocolate has melted. Whisk to dissolve the cocoa.
Pour into a mug, then add the cream to float on top. Grate over a little more chocolate to serve.
